rationale.text: A French page with lang="fra". The glossary accepts a 3-character code from ISO 639-2 and later parts, and fra is the ISO 639-2 code for French. The custom check finds it in its list and answers no_fault. axe's html-lang-valid may fault this code (its list rejects some valid ISO 639-2 codes), but its link is evidence only and changes nothing. Relevance has no check, so the finding is needs_review: not_enabled at fail_only, alternative_unresolved at full.

citations.quote: Code de 2 caractères (ISO 639-1) ou 3 caractères (ISO 639-2 et suivants) permettant d’indiquer la langue d’un document ou d’un passage de texte.
Le code de langue est valide ;
